item.title: CMake, OpenCV, and Unit tests
item.description: For my ongoing Music OCR hobby project, I use OpenCV and C++. For inline text, I’ve been experimenting with OpenCV’s Tesseract support, which relies on the OCRTesseract class from OpenCV’s cv::text package.

item.title: Developer Shell
item.description: For my ongoing MusicOCR hobby project, I experiment a lot with various OpenCV operations and their parameters. In order to make this easier for myself, I’ve built myself a developer shell where I can load an image and apply processing steps to it.

item.title: Music OCR: introducing the idea
item.description: Sometimes I write my own music. I play the piano (badly), and I’ll never be a great composer, but I find it interesting to play around with melody and chords.
